source_text:
Εἶτα ἑλκόμενος ἀπότριβε ἐπὶ
ἀκόνῃ καὶ ποίει ὡς κολλύρια σὺν τῷ ἐνόντι ὑγρῷ, καὶ θαυμάσεις τὴν ἐνέργειαν,
παύσεις δὲ καὶ ἀρχομένας ὑποχύσεις.
pass_a_gloss: Then being-drawn-out rub-off upon a-whetstone and make as collyria with the being-in liquid, and you-will-marvel the activity, you-will-stop but also beginning cataracts.
pass_b_english: Then drawing them out, rub them on a whetstone and make them as collyria with the liquid that is in it, and you will marvel at the activity, and you will also stop beginning cataracts.

lemmas.gloss: the liquid that is in it

choices.why: The grinding-stone for the buried collyria. Not a metal file.
Same eye-salves as §51. CF crib read glue.
ὑπόχυσις is the medical cataract. Not 'you will cease and pour under the beginning'.
rejected: stop the beginnings only as a time

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
